nodes.title: Dark mode editor
nodes.quote: Can we get a dark mode in the editor?

nodes.title: Documents go stale as decisions are made in Slack
nodes.quote: The brief is stale. We agreed in the thread last week to slip the launch by two weeks and nobody updated either doc.

nodes.title: Drafts ship without a measurable success metric
nodes.quote: Reminder that every PRD needs a success metric before it goes to review. Half of the drafts I see this month still have none.

nodes.title: Cross-functional teammates (design and engineering)
nodes.quote: As an engineer I read the brief first. I only open the PRD when I need an edge case.

nodes.title: PMs will trust AI-suggested metrics enough to keep them in the document

evidence.quote: I do not trust a suggested metric unless I can see why it was picked. Show me the reasoning and I will use it.
